dataAccess.title: Active data access
dataAccess.revokeBody: This ends {{holder}}'s access to {{gymName}}'s member and payment records immediately. A reason is required, and this is audit-logged with your identity and a timestamp. They can escalate again if they still need access.
dataAccess.revokeBodySelf: This ends your own access to {{gymName}}'s member and payment records immediately. A reason is required, and this is audit-logged with your identity and a timestamp. You can escalate again if you still need access.
dataAccess.alreadyEndedBody: {{holder}} no longer had access to {{gymName}} — the grant had already expired, or another Super Admin revoked it first. Nothing was changed. Your reason was still recorded in the audit trail.
dataAccess.alreadyEndedBodySelf: You no longer had access to {{gymName}} — the grant had already expired, or another Super Admin revoked it first. Nothing was changed. Your reason was still recorded in the audit trail.
